greatball.description: A wild capture ball with a 1.5× catch modifier.

ultraball.description: A wild capture ball with a 2× catch modifier.

masterball.description: Always catches a wild Pokémon. Cannot capture another trainer’s Pokémon.

netball.description: 3× catch modifier against Water- or Bug-type wild Pokémon; otherwise 1×.

diveball.description: 3.5× catch modifier in underwater terrain; otherwise 1×. Surfing alone is not underwater.

nestball.description: More effective on lower-level wild Pokémon: max(1, (40 − level) / 10)×.

repeatball.description: 3× if this species is already in your caught Pokédex; otherwise 1×. Merely seeing it does not count.

timerball.description: Starts at 1× and gains 0.1× per completed turn, up to 4× after 30 completed turns (GBA rule).

luxuryball.description: A 1× capture ball. Its caught Pokémon gains an extra friendship point when friendship increases.

potion.description: Restores 20 HP to one non-fainted Pokémon.

superpotion.description: Restores 50 HP to one non-fainted Pokémon.

hyperpotion.description: Restores 200 HP to one non-fainted Pokémon.

maxpotion.description: Restores all HP to one non-fainted Pokémon.

freshwater.description: Restores 50 HP to one non-fainted Pokémon.

energypowder.description: Restores 50 HP to one non-fainted Pokémon. Bitter medicine lowers friendship.

energyroot.description: Restores 200 HP to one non-fainted Pokémon. Bitter medicine lowers friendship.

sitrusberry.description: Restores 30 HP to one non-fainted Pokémon. When held: Restores 30 HP when at half HP or lower, then is consumed.

antidote.description: Cures poison / toxic on one Pokémon.

fullheal.description: Cures major status conditions and confusion on one Pokémon.

healpowder.description: Cures major status conditions and confusion on one Pokémon.

ragecookie.description: Cures major status conditions and confusion on one Pokémon.

lumberry.description: Cures major status conditions and confusion on one Pokémon. When held: Automatically cures major status and confusion, then is consumed.

blueflute.description: Cures sleep on one Pokémon. Reusable; not consumed.

yellowflute.description: Cures confusion on one Pokémon. Reusable; not consumed.

fullrestore.description: Fully restores one living Pokémon’s HP and cures major status conditions and confusion.

revive.description: Revives one fainted Pokémon to half HP.

maxrevive.description: Revives one fainted Pokémon to full HP.

revivalherb.description: Revives one fainted Pokémon to full HP. Bitter medicine lowers friendship.

sacredash.description: Revives every fainted member of your current party to full HP. Field use only.

ether.description: Restores 10 PP to one selected move.

maxether.description: Restores all PP to one selected move.

elixir.description: Restores 10 PP to every move of one Pokémon.

maxelixir.description: Restores all PP to every move of one Pokémon.

hpup.description: Adds up to 10 HP effort points, with the GBA vitamin cap of 100 per stat and total EV cap of 510. Increases friendship on successful use.

protein.description: Adds up to 10 Attack effort points, with the GBA vitamin cap of 100 per stat and total EV cap of 510. Increases friendship on successful use.

iron.description: Adds up to 10 Defense effort points, with the GBA vitamin cap of 100 per stat and total EV cap of 510. Increases friendship on successful use.

carbos.description: Adds up to 10 Speed effort points, with the GBA vitamin cap of 100 per stat and total EV cap of 510. Increases friendship on successful use.

calcium.description: Adds up to 10 Special Attack effort points, with the GBA vitamin cap of 100 per stat and total EV cap of 510. Increases friendship on successful use.

zinc.description: Adds up to 10 Special Defense effort points, with the GBA vitamin cap of 100 per stat and total EV cap of 510. Increases friendship on successful use.

ppup.description: Permanently increases a selected move’s maximum PP by one 20% increment, up to three increments. Does not affect Sketch or 1-PP moves.

ppmax.description: Permanently increases a selected move’s maximum PP to all three 20% increments. Does not affect Sketch or 1-PP moves.

rarecandy.description: Raises a Pokémon below level 100 by one level, preserves EXP progression, and processes its native move-learning/evolution choices.

skillcapsule.description: Switches between a species’ two different regular abilities. It does not create an ability or grant a hidden ability. Unsupported destination ability IDs are blocked without consumption.

xattack.description: Raises the active Pokémon’s Attack by one stage for this battle, until it switches out.

xdefend.description: Raises the active Pokémon’s Defense by one stage for this battle, until it switches out.

xspeed.description: Raises the active Pokémon’s Speed by one stage for this battle, until it switches out.

xspecial.description: Raises the active Pokémon’s Special Attack by one stage for this battle, until it switches out.

xaccuracy.description: Raises the active Pokémon’s accuracy by one stage for this battle, until it switches out.

direhit.description: Raises the active Pokémon’s critical-hit stage by two until it switches out. Does not stack with Focus Energy.

guardspec.description: Protects your side against opposing stat reductions for five turns.

repel.description: For 100 successful walking steps, prevents wild encounters below your first party Pokémon’s level. Cannot replace an active Repel.

superrepel.description: For 200 successful walking steps, prevents wild encounters below your first party Pokémon’s level. Cannot replace an active Repel.

maxrepel.description: For 250 successful walking steps, prevents wild encounters below your first party Pokémon’s level. Cannot replace an active Repel.

escaperope.description: Returns to the recorded safe entrance where the source map permits Escape Rope. Cannot be used in battle; no item is spent without a safe destination.

pokeflute.description: Wakes sleeping Pokémon in your party. In battle, wakes both active Pokémon. Reusable.

coincase.description: Reusable coin wallet. At an NXT Poké Mart coin exchange, buy coins or exchange them for displayed prizes. Coins and money are saved atomically.

rotompad.description: Opens your saved Pokédex and trainer/badge records. Reusable; nothing is consumed.

squirtbottle.description: Use at the Route 36 odd tree after earning Whitney’s badge to start the existing Sudowoodo story battle. Reusable.

pokeblockcas.description: Reusable NXT berry-blending case. Blend an owned Lum or Sitrus Berry and feed the resulting block to increase friendship and the displayed contest condition. No contest minigame is simulated.

teraorb.description: NXT battle adaptation: once per battle, Terastallize your active Pokémon into its primary species type alongside an attack. Changes defensive typing and STAB until battle ends. The Orb is not consumed.

policy: Native records are evidence, not executable mechanics. Explicit NXT adapters are marked per item. Machine compatibility is taken from the supplied Sigma table, including unusual assignments. The stale vanilla table at 0x45a5a4 is not used.
